headline: Archipelago remembers save-slot rooms; Difficulty fixes Blarg Station spawns
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0, item-randomizer v1.0.4 and difficulty v1.2.4 were released against Mod SDK 1.11.0. Archipelago now remembers each save slot’s room and rejects another seed’s save, alongside logic, reconnect and client fixes (#24, #26). Difficulty leaves space for Blarg Station’s own objects, preventing extra enemies from making the ship and Clank disappear (#34).
highlights: Players are asked to play-test randomizer and Archipelago access logic, including Trespasser checks on return Veldin, Aridia and Batalia (#25).
Listings now state AI assistance per mod, and releases trigger index rebuilding directly (#33, #27). The listing bot rejects a broken newest release instead of silently offering an older one (#32).
Co-op cross-region play, separate saves, reconnect and host takeover remain in an unmerged draft, not ready for review (#22).
